minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a stormwater permit change at 524 Northfield Rd and a 757 Chase Rd extension; tabled the Leominster Rd land opinion.
minutes.summary: The board approved a modified stormwater permit for lot A at 524 Northfield Road and a one-year extension for the Subaru dealership at 757 Chase Road. It discussed the right of first refusal on a Leominster Road parcel and tabled its recommendation until the Open Space committee gives one. Board discussion covered the master plan, solar bylaw changes, a common driveway draft, and a scenic road bylaw after trees were cut on Flat Hill Road.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted unanimously to approve a modified stormwater permit for lot A at 524 Northfield Road, after closing the public hearing.
The board approved a one-year extension of the site plan approval and stormwater permit for 757 Chase Road; staff will send the applicant a confirming letter.
The board tabled its recommendation on the right of first refusal for a Leominster Road parcel until the Open Space committee gives its own; one member apparently dissented.
Members discussed what the parcel might cost, how an appraiser would be hired, and whether remaining ARPA money could pay for an appraisal. No figure was settled.
After trees were cut on Flat Hill Road, staff were asked to bring example scenic road bylaws to the board within about a week.

why_it_matters: The Leominster Road parcel decision now depends on the Open Space committee acting, and a member noted the delay could leave the board without a timely recommendation on a town purchase option.
A scenic road bylaw would affect when trees and stone walls along town roads can be cut, so a bylaw may later come before residents for a vote.
watch_next: Planning Board meetings on July 10 and July 24 at six pm, including the common driveway bylaw outline and the scenic road bylaw examples.
The Open Space committee's recommendation on the Leominster Road right of first refusal.
